furnishing.body:
Editorial guidelines

Every article starts as a draft. Drafts are visible to your team only, and a preview link can be shared with reviewers outside the workspace for seven days.

Headlines run to sixty characters. Anything longer is truncated in search results and in the cards used across category pages, so write the short version first.

Images need descriptive alternative text. Decorative images may leave it empty, but photographs of people, charts, and screenshots always carry a description.

Publishing is reversible. Unpublishing returns an article to draft and keeps every revision, so nothing you write here is ever lost.

examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mb-3">Terms of service <.component component_name="chelekom-scroll-area" site="Global" id="tos-scroll" height="h-56" type="hover" padding="small" class="rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">

By creating an account you agree to keep your credentials confidential and to accept responsibility for any activity that happens under them.

You keep ownership of everything you publish. We store and serve that content solely to operate the service on your behalf.

Plans renew automatically on the anniversary of the purchase. Cancelling stops the next renewal and leaves the current period untouched.

We may suspend an account that sends unsolicited email or hosts material that infringes someone else's rights, after notifying the account owner.

These terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which the service is registered.

<.component component_name="chelekom-checkbox-field" site="Global" id="tos-accept" name="accept_terms" value="true" space="small" label="I have read and accept the terms of service" />
